content_parts.content:
The customer 360 view provides a comprehensive overview of your customer at a glance, so that you can manage them effectively and efficiently.

You can customize your own personalized 360 views to match your workflow. From this one central view, you can:

  • Instantly access key customer details and contacts.
  • Display KPIs to gain deeper insights and make smarter decisions.
  • Highlight in progress sales orders to act quickly.
  • Create sales orders and perform key actions from a single page.

You asked. We listened.

Efficiently track and manage invoice and credit memo information in one place with the Purchase invoice line inquiry.

The inquiry is available:

  • From the Purchasing > Purchasing inquiries menu
  • From the Purchase order line inquiry page and the Purchase receipt line inquiry page, which enables access to invoice or credit memo lines related to a specific purchase order or receipt line.

You can put a customer on hold and make them active again using the Put on hold and Remove hold actions for the customer record.

You can add an image to a customer contact.

Use the Serial number stock inquiry to view items with assigned serial numbers that are currently in stock or allocated. For allocated serial numbers, a link is provided to view the allocation details.
You need to activate the serialNumberOption service option to use the Serial number stock inquiry.
